homepage.about.description.message: Fullstack Developer with a rare profile that combines over 10 years of programming study with a deep sensitivity for design and UX/UI. I have expertise in the architecture of complete digital solutions, developing performant applications with TypeScript and strategically choosing database technology — PostgreSQL for relational structures or MongoDB for high-flexibility scenarios — to ensure the scalability and efficiency of the final product.

conduct.pledge.p1.message: I, as the creator and maintainer of tupynambalucas.dev, pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

conduct.pledge.p2.message: I pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive, and healthy community.

conduct.responsibilities.p1.message: As the maintainer of this project, I am responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior that I deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

conduct.responsibilities.p2.message: I have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned to this Code of Conduct, and will communicate reasons for moderation decisions when appropriate.

conduct.standards.positive.intro.message: Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment for this project include:

conduct.standards.positive.1.message: Demonstrating empathy and kindness toward other people.

conduct.standards.positive.2.message: Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences.

conduct.standards.positive.3.message: Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback.

conduct.standards.positive.4.message: Accepting responsibility and apologizing to those affected by our mistakes, and learning from the experience.

conduct.standards.positive.5.message: Focusing on what is best for the overall community.

conduct.standards.unacceptable.1.message: The use of sexualized language or imagery, and sexual attention or advances of any kind.

conduct.standards.unacceptable.2.message: Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks.

conduct.standards.unacceptable.4.message: Publishing others' private information, such as a physical or email address, without their explicit permission.

conduct.standards.unacceptable.5.message: Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

conduct.scope.p1.message: This Code of Conduct applies within all community spaces related to tupynambalucas.dev, and also applies when an individual is officially representing the project in public spaces.

conduct.enforcement.p1.message: Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported directly to me at

conduct.enforcement.p1.2.message: All complaints will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

conduct.enforcement.p2.message: I am obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter of any incident.

homepage.hero.text.primary.message: Welcome to the central documentation hub for the {domain} monorepo. This platform serves as the single source of truth for my personal website, engineering services, dynamic asset engines, and production-grade developer workspaces.

homepage.profile.bio.message: Full-Stack Engineer with over 10 years of experience and studies in software development, building production systems in TypeScript from end to end. I make architectural decisions driven by requirements, not by trends — selecting the right database, framework, or protocol for each problem. My current expertise runs deep in MongoDB replica sets with ACID transactions, but I reach for PostgreSQL or Redis when the domain calls for it. I design domain-driven monorepos orchestrated by Turborepo with strict catalog-managed dependencies, ship high-performance APIs on Fastify with Redis-backed job queues, and craft interactive frontends with React 19, Three.js, and GSAP. My infrastructure runs on Docker and Kubernetes with Traefik ingress, OpenTelemetry-instrumented observability pipelines exporting to Grafana Cloud, and multi-environment promotion from dev to production. I architect AI-native toolchains — self-hosted MCP gateway federations, containerized agent runtimes, and vector memory layers — turning autonomous workflows into first-class infrastructure. Every repository I own ships with automated CI/CD, Conventional Commits, and security hardened by design.

homepage.dosolo.item1.description.message: Context-driven root layout using PNPM Workspaces and Turborepo for optimized task orchestration.

homepage.dosolo.item2.description.message: Strictly-typed business logic and schemas defined as single source of truth for all applications.

homepage.dosolo.item3.description.message: Deep integration with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and design-to-code bridges for high-context automation.
